title: harness node half fails at base: dumb-git-origin test under its own 300s rule
body:
harness-timeout-discipline.test.ts flags node/dumb-git-origin.test.ts's first test (declares timeout 120_000) as process-driving, which the guard requires to declare at least 300_000. Reproduced verbatim at the base commit 9eb73179f53f in a scratch worktree, so it is pre-existing and not introduced by this tick; it fails every full `pnpm test` run of the harness node half, which CI runs as its own job beside the Go one.
evidence: harness/test/node/dumb-git-origin.test.ts:147 declares { timeout: 120_000 } while harness/test/node/harness-timeout-discipline.test.ts:495 fails with 'expected [node/dumb-git-origin.test.ts: an origin that outlives the box carries the boot, the wip and the restore] to deeply equal []'
